Figure 1:Framework of Embodied-Harness.(a)The Actor performs task
execution through a perception–action loop
guided by the execution harness.(b)Hierarchical memory maintains
short-term execution context and long-term
experience across attempts and tasks.(c)The Reflector analyzes execution
evidence and experience to
diagnose failures and identify improvements.(d)Recursive harness self-improvement
generates guidance and refines
operational knowledge to improve subsequent
execution without updating model parameters.
Figure 3:Execution examples on three real-world tasks.
